biological_meaning: {response} varies normally around its expected value
Expected {response} is a linear combination of the mean-model predictors
Log residual SD of {response} is a linear combination of the scale-model predictors
Observations are conditionally independent given the predictors
Observations are conditionally independent given the predictors and the random effects
Residual SD is constrained positive via the log link
Observations are assumed not missing in a way that depends on the unobserved response
Each row of {response} is normal around its per-trait mean plus a contribution from the between-unit latent factors
Each trait has its own grand-mean intercept
Between-unit latent scores are independent standard normal
The loading matrix is parameterised lower-triangular with positive diagonal so it is identified up to sign
The between-unit T x T covariance is the latent product plus the diagonal of per-trait unique variances (\boldsymbol{\Psi}_B = 0 when no unique() term is present)
Row-level residual SD is constrained positive
Rows of {response} are conditionally independent given the latent scores
Observations are assumed not missing in a way that depends on the unobserved response
